newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada buys Canadian dollars - traders.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada buys Canadian dollars - traders.

text.p: The Bank of Canada intervened on Thursday and bought Canadian dollars for U.S. dollars at the C$1.3590 (US$0.7358) level after the unit weakened overnight and threatened to break C$1.3600 (US$0.7352), dealers said.
The intervention was through brokers and considered light as the currency weakened through key support.
Following the intervention, the Canadian dollar was trading at C$1.3585 after opening at C$1.3572 and Wednesday's close of C$1.3533. Traders expected a further decline.
The Bank of Canada does not comment on intervention.
